name: Decree heavy pulse turret
description: A turret of fast heavy pulses, fired in the long, regular volleys the Concord Navy prefers.

name: Decree grand pulse turret
description: The Decree at flagship scale. Each pulse is the size of a shuttle and arrives with a signed order.

name: Ruling rail battery
description: A long-barrelled rail turret with a gold-banded muzzle. Fast, bright and accurate at distance.

name: Ruling grand rail battery
description: The heaviest rail turret in the Concord inventory. Its slug is a final judgement.

name: Ordinance flak battery
description: A point-defence battery that fills the space around a ship with bursting shells. Fighters tend to avoid the area.

name: Writ torpedo launcher
description: A slow, heavy homing torpedo issued against capital ships, one at a time and with full paperwork.

name: Petition missile rack
description: A small homing missile on a light rack, fitted to fighters on request.

name: Petition twin missile rack
description: A twin rack of homing missiles with a larger warhead. Approved for gunships and fighters alike.
